adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Aboard the Benatar, Drax tells Thor that Gamora is Thanos's daughter. On Knowhere, he yells at Thanos for taking her captive, and Thanos breaks him into pieces.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Drax tries to save from Thanos on Knowhere.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Thor she is Thanos's daughter. Struck down trying to save her.
adds.evidence: Benatar: Drax reveals to Thor that Gamora is Thanos's adopted daughter. Knowhere: Drax yells at Thanos for taking Gamora captive and Thanos incapacitates him with the Reality Stone, turning him to pieces.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Groot swears at Quill over his game aboard the Benatar, Drax and the rest of the crew react in shock.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teenage teammate whose swearing shocks Drax and the crew.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who reacts in shock when Groot swears at Quill.
adds.evidence: Benatar: Quill tells Groot to put his game away, Groot answers 'I am Groot' rudely and the crew (dialogue credited to Star-Lord, Groot, Gamora, Drax and Rocket) reacts in an uproar.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: On Knowhere, Mantis puts Drax to sleep to stop him charging Thanos too soon. On Titan, Drax watches her fade away in the Snap before he fades too.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Puts Drax to sleep on Knowhere. Fades before his eyes on Titan.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Mantis puts to sleep on Knowhere. Fades right after her on Titan.
adds.evidence: Knowhere: Mantis uses her powers to make Drax sleep when he charges Thanos early. Titan: Mantis says something is happening and disintegrates; Drax watches in alarm and disintegrates next.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: On Knowhere, Quill tries to hold Drax back from charging Thanos too soon. On Titan, Drax calls out to Quill as he fades away in the Snap.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Holds Drax back on Knowhere. The one Drax calls out to as he fades.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Charges Thanos too soon on Knowhere. Calls out to Quill as he fades.
adds.evidence: Knowhere: 'Drax, wait! Not yet' as Quill tries to restrain him. Titan: Drax's last word is 'Quill?' as he disintegrates.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Aboard the Benatar, Drax and Rocket tease Quill about his weight while the Guardians look after the rescued Thor.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who joins Drax in teasing Quill about his weight.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who joins Rocket in teasing Quill about his weight.
adds.evidence: Benatar, after Thor is brought aboard: Drax and Rocket talk about Quill's weight gain while the team works out how Thor survived.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Tony has F.R.I.D.A.Y. clear New York's streets as Thanos's ship arrives, and she patches Pepper's call through as he follows the ship into space.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s boss, whose call from Pepper she relays as he leaves Earth.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I., who clears New York's streets and relays Pepper's call.
adds.evidence: New York: 'F.R.I.D.A.Y., evac anyone south of 43rd Street, notify first responders.' 'Will do.' Then 'Boss, incoming call from Miss Potts' and 'Boss, we're losing her' as Tony rides the Q-Ship out of the atmosphere.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Groot swears at Quill over his game aboard the Benatar, Gamora and the rest of the crew react in shock.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teenage teammate whose swearing shocks Gamora and the crew.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who reacts in shock when Groot swears at Quill.
adds.evidence: Benatar: Quill tells Groot to put his game away, Groot answers rudely and the crew (dialogue credited to Star-Lord, Groot, Gamora, Drax and Rocket) reacts in an uproar.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Mantis goes with Gamora to Knowhere to stop Thanos, and Thanos strikes Mantis down as he takes Gamora captive.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Goes with Gamora to Knowhere. Struck down as Thanos takes her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Thanos takes captive on Knowhere.
adds.evidence: Knowhere: Quill, Gamora, Drax and Mantis confront Thanos; as he takes Gamora hostage the Guardians try to save her and he takes out Drax and Mantis with the Reality Stone.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Rocket asks why the Guardians are answering a distress call, Gamora tells him someone could be dying, and the rescue brings them to Thor.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Asks why they answer the distress call. Gamora says someone could be dying.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Rocket they answer the distress call because someone could be dying.
adds.evidence: Opening of the Guardians' storyline: 'Why are we doing this again?' 'It's a distress signal, Rocket. Someone could be dying.' (Rocket and Gamora).

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Aboard the Benatar, Quill orders Groot to put his game away, and Groot swears at him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Orders Groot to put his game away and gets sworn at.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teenage teammate who swears at Quill over his game.
adds.evidence: Benatar: 'Groot, put that thing away, now. I don't want to tell you again.' 'I am Groot.' Groot rudely insults Quill's demand to focus on the mission.
